purpose: Declared local changes to the 907cfa8 port; original upstream fingerprints retained. DEF11: recommendation-fit remediation (controller). Recommendation v2: native contract 2.0 (feedback snapshot, pool cache, native geography, fused-v2 full-pool scoring, select-v1 selection, slim trace), branch feat/recommendation-exploration; see evaluation/recommendation-exploration-2026-10-23/MIGRATION.md. files.issue: DEF11 controller terminal output and final-gate recovery; Recommendation v2 (native contract 2.0; spec evaluation/recommendation-exploration-2026-10-23, MIGRATION.md)
changes: Complete assessed empty rankings through the existing final gate
Retain tool history and explicit error feedback across bounded final-gate repairs
